# Recipe Time

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The time-related metadata for a recipe, such as preparation time, cook time, and total time.

## Scope note

A recipe metadata attribute distinct from RecipeServings and Nutrition; used in recipe detail displays.

## Broader

- [Recipe](../Recipe/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
